meta.name: fluidsim
meta.description: Framework for computational fluid dynamics simulations using Python. Use when running fluid dynamics simulations including Navier-Stokes equations (2D/3D), shallow water equations, stratified flows, or when analyzing turbulence, vortex dynamics, or geophysical flows. Provides pseudospectral methods with FFT, HPC support, and comprehensive output analysis.

copy.tagline: 用Python运行流体动力学模拟
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要进行CFD模拟或研究流体力学
copy.tagline_en: Run fluid dynamics simulations with Python
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run CFD simulations or study fluid mechanics

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你用 Python 运行流体动力学模拟，包括 2D/3D 纳维-斯托克斯方程、浅水方程、分层流等。它会生成参数配置、执行模拟并输出结果（如涡量图、能谱）。
howto.when: 当你要求进行流体动力学模拟（如湍流、涡旋动力学、地球物理流）时触发。

say.text: 用 fluidsim 的 ns2d.strat 求解器模拟分层流，设置 N=2。
say.note: Claude 会配置参数并执行。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you run computational fluid dynamics simulations in Python, including 2D/3D Navier-Stokes, shallow water, and stratified flows. It generates parameter configurations, executes simulations, and outputs results like vorticity plots and spectra.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request fluid dynamics simulations such as turbulence, vortex dynamics, or geophysical flows.

say_en.text: Run a 2D turbulence simulation with fluidsim, grid 256x256, viscosity 1e-3.
say_en.note: Claude will generate and run the simulation code.

say_en.text: Use fluidsim's ns2d.strat solver for stratified flow with N=2.
say_en.note: Claude will configure parameters and execute.
